messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR for the on‑prem migration guide. Primary focus: sample configs for KMS/HSM wiring, plus air-gapped install notes. I pushed an initial draft & a couple of example YAMLs. github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 :wave:
jordan: linking the PR — thanks. Can you call out any breaking changes customers should watch for when moving from hosted -> private KMS?
sam: @maya can you paste the sample systemd unit & the minimal nginx proxy snippet here? Easier to eyeball in-thread first.
maya: sure. Minimal nginx proxy (used in the airgap docs to forward internal KMS requests):
```nginx
server {
  listen 127.0.0.1:8443;
  server_name localhost;

  location /kms/ {
    proxy_pass https://kms.internal:8443/;
    proxy_set_header Host $host;
    proxy_ssl_trusted_certificate /etc/ssl/certs/kms-root.pem;
  }
}
```
And a tiny systemd service we reference for the HSM agent:
```ini
[Unit]
Description=HSM agent
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/hsm-agent --config /etc/hsm/agent.yaml
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
ryan: nice. On the KMS wording, suggest replacing "ensure private keys are mounted" with "ensure KMS wraps keys and only the KMS host holds unencrypted private material" — less ambiguous. Also add note about TLS SNI requirements for some HSM vendor plugins.
maya: good catch. I'll update the phrasing and add a short vendor note. Any specific HSM vendors we should call out? I'm thinking generic + one example (thales/equivalent) so it doesn't feel vendor‑specific.
jordan: mention PKCS#11 path layout differences — we had at least two customers confused by `/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so` vs `/usr/local/lib/pkcs11.so`. A tiny troubleshooting tip helps.
sam: small nit: in the airgap install steps, step 4 says "download runtime images" — add a link to the internal artifact mirror command and note the SHA256 check. Eg:
`curl -O https://artifacts.redwood.internal/release-2025-11/images.tar.gz && sha256sum -c images.tar.gz.sha256`
maya: added both the sha256 check and a short `scp` fallback example for environments with no outbound access. Also marked the PR as "docs: nonblocking review" for quick review only.
docs-bot: PR 1234: label set to docs-review. 3 reviewers requested: @ryan, @sam, @jordan.
ryan: will review this afternoon. Focusing on networking and HSM sections. If it's small wording + snippets, should be quick. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all. If reviewers agree, I'll merge post‑CI and then backport a simplified note into the migration checklist page. Leaving a TODO to add a short script that validates PKCS#11 paths on customer hosts (could land as a follow-up)
